summary: City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, referred Item NY16.13, headed "Application to Remove a City-Owned Tree - 143 Plewes Road" back to North York Community Council for further consideration. ________ The report (May 14, 2020) from the Director, Urban Forestry, Parks, Forestry and Recreation recommends that: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove a City-owned tree located at 143 Plewes Road. The subject tree is a Freeman maple (Acer x freemanii), measuring 21 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
decided: City Council on September 30, October 1 and 2, 2020, did not adopt Item NY17.24.
